metadata.display_name: Retrieve List Of Automation Flows (Automation V4)
metadata.description: Retrieve a list of automation flows available in your HubSpot account.
metadata.learn_more: Retrieve a list of automation flows available in your HubSpot account. This endpoint supports pagination to navigate through large sets of flows, allowing you to specify the number of results per page and to continue from a specific point in the list using a cursor token.

after.label: After
after.description: The paging cursor token of the last successfully read resource will be returned as the `paging.next.after` JSON property of a paged response containing more results.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: The maximum number of results to return, with a default value of 100.
